results.original_text: As a site editor, I want to have pretty good control over how the article, so that articles are visually appealing.
results.final_text:
User Story:
As a site editor, I want to have comprehensive control over the formatting and layout of articles so that they are visually engaging and enhance reader retention.

Acceptance Criteria:
- Editors must be able to customize font styles, sizes, and colors for at least 95% of text elements within the article.
- The layout editor should allow for drag-and-drop functionality to rearrange content blocks, achieving user satisfaction ratings of 85% or higher.
- Articles should maintain a mobile-responsive design, ensuring that layout adjustments do not compromise readability on devices of varying screen sizes, with a performance score of 90% or above.

Test Outline:
- Test the formatting tools to verify that all customization options are functional and user-friendly.
- Gather feedback from editors on the usability of the layout features through surveys to assess satisfaction and identify areas for improvement.

history.text:
User Story:
As a site editor, I want to have comprehensive control over the article formatting and layout so that I can ensure that each article is visually appealing and engages readers effectively.

Acceptance Criteria:
- The editing interface must allow customization of article elements (fonts, images, headings) with at least 10 predefined styles to choose from.
- Users should be able to preview changes in real-time, ensuring that at least 95% of edits accurately reflect in the published version.
- The time taken to apply and save formatting changes should not exceed 5 seconds for 90% of users, maintaining an efficient workflow.

Test Outline:
- Test the article formatting tools to ensure all customization options are available and functional.
- Conduct user feedback sessions to confirm that the real-time preview accurately represents the final published appearance.

results.original_text: I want a search bar on the top of the page.
results.final_text:
User Story:
As a website visitor, I want a prominently placed search bar at the top of the page so that I can easily locate content and navigate the site efficiently.

Acceptance Criteria:
- The search bar must be visible on all pages and accessible within 2 clicks from any location on the site, enhancing user navigability.
- The search functionality should return relevant results within 3 seconds for at least 95% of queries, ensuring users find what they need quickly.
- The design of the search bar must be responsive, functioning seamlessly on both desktop and mobile devices, achieving a usability score of 90% or higher.

Test Outline:
- Navigate through various pages to verify the search bar's visibility and accessibility.
- Perform search tests to measure the response time and relevance of results for a variety of queries.
- Conduct usability testing on different devices to assess the performance and user experience of the search bar.
